Woman Allegedly Hires Lover to Kill Husband, Three Arrested

In Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Telangana, a woman has been arrested for allegedly hiring her lover to kill her husband. Three individuals have been taken into custody in connection with the incident. Reports suggest the alleged murder plot involved pesticide-laced liquor.
